messages.content: Help me determine if an email form element referred to as 'emailForm' includes an input with the name attribute 'emailAddress'?

function.name: doesEmailInputExist
function.description: This function verifies whether a given email form contains an input with a specific 'name' attribute value. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

formElem.description: The email form element to inspect. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.

inputName.description: The value of the 'name' attribute to look for in the input. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.
